integrity: The complete geometric proof and standalone finite exact checker are included. Published general tables may contain a reconstructible related orbit type; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns one explicitly defined degree-one del Pezzo surface over F5 and its finite extensions; identifies curve fields of definition and global intersection numbers, not explicit curve equations or local intersections. The root-lattice action uses elliptic-surface identification and published irreducibility of geometric fibers.
title: Frobenius orbits and the cubic-extension hexagon of exceptional curves on a degree-one del Pezzo surface
